key_findings.mechanism: When SICA is wrong, 94% of the time it follows the SC majority-vote answer. FOL constraints from LLM traces systematically support the trace's own answer, so when most traces answer incorrectly, the constraints overwhelmingly point to the wrong answer (83.3% wrong vs 16.7% gold).
key_findings.bias_ratio_wrong_vs_correct: 4.97x more constraint weight toward wrong answers vs gold in SICA-wrong cases
key_findings.sica_adds_value_when: SC wrong but SICA correct (12 cases): constraints still lean wrong (57%) but gold support (43%) is enough to flip the answer — suggests constraint diversity from minority traces can sometimes overcome majority bias
key_findings.sica_rarely_hurts: Only 2 cases where SC correct but SICA wrong — SICA almost never overrides a correct SC answer
